apps.name: Training Log
apps.subtitle: Strength training log for the gym
apps.localizedDescription: Log your strength workouts the Apple way. Group exercises into sessions, track sets and weight, see per-exercise progress charts. Replaces your Notes app for gym tracking.

versions.localizedDescription: Custom exercises now properly count toward your volume. When you create a new exercise the app asks which muscles it works (multi-select), and saves the answer for next time. Swipe-to-edit on existing custom exercises adds muscles to any untagged ones. New Export button (top-left of Log tab) generates a full Markdown file of all your sessions, exercise PRs, weekly volume, and detailed sets — share to Files, AirDrop to Mac, or paste into Claude for personal coaching.

Smart Effort — sports science upgrade. RPE field (6–10) on every set, optional. Estimated 1RM card and trend chart per exercise (Epley formula). Weekly volume dashboard on Progress with MEV/MAV/MRV landmarks per muscle (Renaissance Periodization). Coach now reads your RPE: easy set → push harder, hard set → consolidate.

🇩🇪 Deutsch jetzt verfügbar (folgt der Systemsprache). New "Today" tab — AI suggests a full session based on muscle groups you haven't hit recently, with smart sets/reps/weight per exercise. Tap "Start This Session" to launch a workout pre-loaded with the suggestion.
🏋️ Real dumbbell app icon. Designed for light, dark, and tinted iOS home screens. Plus the AltStore source icon is updated to match.

AI Coach (Layer 1). When you open a new exercise, the reps and weight pre-fill with a smart next-progression suggestion based on your last sessions. New "Coach Suggests" callout explains the reasoning. Hit the same weight twice → it suggests +2.5 kg. Reps dropped → it tells you to repeat. First time → it matches last session.

Visual glow-up. Brand accent color, this-week stats hero, card-based session and exercise rows, big-number summaries, previous-best callout on exercises, quick weight step buttons (±1.25 / ±2.5 kg), sparkline previews on progress.
Fix: tapping an exercise inside a session now opens the set-logging screen. Add: Done button on the number-pad keyboard.
Initial release. Sessions, exercises, set logging, progress charts.

apps.name: Imker Kalender
apps.subtitle: Imkerjahr für Vorarlberg / Alpenraum
apps.localizedDescription: Dein persönlicher Imker-Kalender mit allen Aufgaben über das Jahr — angepasst an alpine Höhenlage (~700 m, Montafon). Varroa-Management, Schwarmkontrolle, Tracht, Einwinterung. Pro Aufgabe: Was, Warum, Wie + alpine Hinweise. Abhakbar pro Monat/Jahr. Notizen pro Erledigung.

versions.localizedDescription: Markdown-Export aller Völker. Export-Button im Völker-Tab (oben links). Generiert eine vollständige .md-Datei mit Übersicht, pro Standort Tabelle, chronologischer Aktivitäts-Timeline und Volk-für-Volk Tagebuch. Via Share-Sheet sendbar an Files, AirDrop, Mail, oder direkt in Claude.ai für persönliche Imker-Coaching.

Neue Tab "Völker": Mehrere Bienenvölker, gruppiert nach Standort. Pro Volk: Name, Königinfarbe (Weiß/Gelb/Rot/Grün/Blau nach internationalem Imker-Standard), Markierungsjahr, Notizen. Persönliches Tagebuch pro Volk — Datum + Aktion + Notizen. Schnellwahl für häufige Aktionen (Durchsicht, Schwarmkontrolle, Honig geerntet, AS/OS-Behandlung, etc).
App komplett auf Deutsch (de_AT) gezwungen — Datumsformate, Monatsnamen, Zahlenformate immer Deutsch, unabhängig von der System-Sprache. CFBundleDevelopmentRegion auf de gesetzt.
Erste Version. Aktuell-Tab mit kritischen Aufgaben des Monats, Jahres-Tab mit allen 12 Monaten ausklappbar. Detail-Ansicht pro Aufgabe mit Was/Warum/Wie und alpinen Anpassungen für Vorarlberg.
